text: reader covers $PROB, $PARAM (plain @annotated), $THETA, $CMT, $INIT, $MAIN/$PK, $ODE/$DES, $TABLE/$ERROR, $CAPTURE, $PKMODEL, $OMEGA $SIGMA (@block), $NMXML/$NMEXT sources NONMEM estimates. Blocks may also written [ NAME ]. Code C++ subset mrgsolve documents models: declarations assignments, /else, arithmetic, comparisons, exp(), log(), log10(), sqrt(), fabs(), pow(), fmin(), fmax(), ETA(n), EPS(n), THETA(n), macros dxdt_CMT, F_CMT, ALAG_CMT, R_CMT, D_CMT CMT_0. Anything else, including $GLOBAL, $PREAMBLE, nm-vars plugin, int declarations integer division (3/4), refused error class zufapmx_parse_error. $PKMODEL may take parameters $PARAM directly $MAIN. Recorded losses read: title, $PLUGIN, $SET, $PARAM descriptions, $PARAM values written constant expressions (log(2)), evaluated, $TABLE outputs Y use. Time t: read SOLVERTIME $ODE TIME elsewhere; name refused, since different time. $NMXML $NMEXT resolve relative path working directory, model file's root = "cppfile", mrgsolve . observation Y $TABLE, written prediction IPRED; residual model recognised NONMEM. @annotated $PARAM description form [lower, upper], optionally followed fixed, gives parameter's bounds, pmx_write_mrgsolve() writes .
